title: functions.executions.response.streaming.VectorCompletionTaskChunk
description:
A chunk in a streaming vector completion response.

Each chunk contains incremental updates to the completion. Use the
[`push`](Self::push) method to accumulate chunks into a complete response.

id.description: Unique identifier for this vector completion.

completions.description: Incremental agent completion chunks from each agent.

votes.description: Votes received so far. New votes are appended in subsequent chunks.

scores.description: Current weighted scores. Updated as new votes arrive.

weights.description: Current weight distribution across responses. Updated as new votes arrive.

created.description: Unix timestamp when the completion was created.

ensemble.description: ID of the ensemble used for this completion.

usage.description: Aggregated usage statistics. Typically present only in the final chunk.
